note: Mason County, MI publishes its zoning map only as a PDF document (Municode munidocs) and the city of Ludington publishes its zoning map as a PDF. The county Parcel GIS viewer (experience.arcgis.com/experience/8048aff205354af694c250389ec90b92) draws parcels, PLSS, municipal boundaries and roads from ArcGIS services but no zoning layer. The parcel layer on services6.arcgis.com (Parcels_2026) has no zoning field. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the state GIS portal found no Mason County or Ludington/Scottville zoning district service.
